exposure: Analysis by type of antiepileptic drug monotherapy
cohort: Women with first and second births in the Medical Birth Registry of Norway, 1999-2013
finding: Women with epilepsy had an increased risk of elective cesarean section and induction of labor in their second birth compared to women without epilepsy, but their risk of other pregnancy complications was not increased.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean section rates were higher in the second birth compared to the first birth for women with epilepsy.
